purpose: Teach: アテネ/アーキテクチャ/メーリングリスト/ファイナンス/エステ/ゲリラ/アイヌ/名乗る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、アテネ風カフェにしたいの
lines.en: Sho, I'd really like to make our home café feel more like an Athens-style place.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. Speaking as if picturing it aloud. Warm and inviting tone, slightly dreamy. Soft modulation, unhurried. The tone of someone sharing a vision they've been turning over in their mind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、家のアーキテクチャって難しいって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard that designing a home is really complicated.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the question. Genuinely curious, not performing. Soft attack on the opening. Natural child's pace — thinking out loud a little. Small hesitation before "complicated," like he's trying the idea on.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメーリングリストでお仕事の連絡してたよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was actually talking about work stuff on the mailing list.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not quite a correction. Mild, conversational tone. Speaking as if sharing something she noticed. No judgment — just passing along a detail. Trailing softly, like she's offering it as a thought.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんからお家のファイナンスを習ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa taught me how to think about home finances.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the words, but understated — not bragging. Steady, slightly formal tone for a six-year-old. He's reporting something he's learned and is careful about getting it right. Firm on "taught" and "finances."

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんがエステに通っているそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your mum's been going to a spa lately, I've heard.
lines.style: Light, casual mention — something she picked up in conversation. Warm, unbothered tone. Slight smile in the delivery. Not gossipy, just sharing an observation. Breathes easily through it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ゲリラ雨でずぶ濡れになっちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got absolutely soaked in that sudden downpour.
lines.style: Wry, matter-of-fact tone with a hint of dry humor underneath. Quick, almost self-deprecating. A small laugh waiting at the edges. He's not complaining — more like reporting something ridiculous that happened to him. Light and resigned.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアイヌ語のお話、教えてくれたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me the most interesting story about the Ainu language.
lines.style: Engaged and attentive, as if she's been genuinely moved by what she heard. Thoughtful pacing. Warm, interested tone — not performing, but genuinely pleased to share this. Slight lift on "Ainu language," treating it with respect.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに名前を名乗るね, 本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, I properly introduced myself to Dad with my own name.
lines.style: Soft pride and sincerity. Speaking carefully — this matters to him. Slight emphasis on "my own name" and "properly." Earnest and present, not rushed. The tone of a child marking something important he's done.
